name: Ophelia of the Glass Fields
source:
Ophelia of the Glass Field is a member of the Class of Exemplary Acolytes. She specializes in Alienist Biomancy, and is one of the Xetaeiwyr [Wyrmkin] from the Diakos.

[Edited from [url=https://everblossom.miraheze.org/wiki/Ophelia_of_the_Glass_Fields]The Flower That Bloomed Nowhere Wiki[/url]]
